name: Ranged Attacks and Range
summary: A weapon range written as two numbers, such as 80/240 ft, lists its normal range first and maximum range second. Attacks made at or within normal range are resolved normally. Attacks beyond normal range and up to maximum range are made with disadvantage. A target beyond maximum range cannot be attacked with that weapon. Area weapons that list a cone, line or radius use that listed area instead of normal range bands unless their profile says otherwise.
